children: Watches of Switzerland set a good pace in its fiscal first quarter but the second half of the year is likely to be less dynamic, Jefferies analyst James Grzinic cautions. The U.K.-based retailer backed its fiscal 2027 guidance after booking strong trading over the summer months. "We believe that unchanged full-year guidance reflects expectations of a likely less dynamic second half," Grzinic writes in a note. Shares lose 1.5% in morning trading in London, joining a slide in other European luxury stocks. (joshua.kirby@wsj.com; @joshualeokirby)
